extraction_notes: The BZT52C2V7S electrical-characteristics row reports VZ minimum 2.5 V, nominal 2.7 V, and maximum 2.9 V at IZT = 5 mA; the nominal value is recorded as the typical breakdown voltage.
The datasheet publishes no numeric capacitance table value, reverse-recovery time, or separate target-specific forward-voltage characteristics.
The page 3 plots are series-level characteristic plots and do not provide an individually identifiable BZT52C2V7S curve with unambiguous target-specific points.
omission_reason: No target-specific usable curve was extracted: the datasheet plots are shared series-level characteristics, and the BZT52C2V7S trace is not individually identified with unambiguous numeric points. Capacitance is also shown only in a shared typical series plot without a target-specific tabulated value.
